title: JSON Formatter
description: JSON formatter to beautify, minify, and validate JSON in your browser. Optional Draft 7 or 2020-12 JSON Schema validation with source diagnostics.
indexDescription: Format, validate JSON syntax, and optionally check JSON Schema contracts in one client-side tool. Supports Draft 7 and Draft 2020-12, local references, selectable indentation, key sorting, tree view, and source diagnostics.
